annotation.title_clean: Colombia elige una inteligencia artificial centrada en la vida, los derechos y el interés público con radicación del proyecto de ley de IA
annotation.title_en: Colombia chooses an artificial intelligence centered on life, rights and public interest with filing of the AI bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC), Colombia
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Colombian MinTIC press release announcing that the TIC and Science ministers filed a national AI bill in Congress. It promotes ethical, sustainable AI with a risk-based approach (prohibited, high, limited, low), addressing bias, privacy, civil and criminal liability, workforce training and governance, aligned with OECD, UNESCO and EU models.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill filed in Congress on AI development, with risk tiers: prohibited, high, limited, low
Mechanisms to prevent algorithmic bias, discrimination and privacy violations
Establishes civil and criminal responsibilities for AI misuse
Training programs and mitigation of automation's employment impact
Aligned with OECD, UNESCO, EU, UK, Brazil, Argentina and Chile models
